title: Tray chip→type_idx arming for mid/high tiers has zero automated coverage
detail: Review guard names a wrong-tier chip a real defect. Demos drive `place <type>` by name (harness/demo.odin:312-327 "at <n>ms place <type> <x> <y>"), bypassing tray clicks; app/ has zero *_test.odin files. The chip→type_idx handoff is only manually verifiable.
recommended_fix: Add an app-level test or harness input-replay capture that clicks each router chip and asserts the placed node's type_idx and tier.

title: Unit tests pin placement tunables against embedded mirrors, not data/balance.json
detail: A retune in data/balance.json (e.g. sep 3) passes every unit test — test_catalog and BAL_VALID mirror the values, never load the real file. Only the catalog_hash golden flags it; a deliberate re-bless could ship a silently wrong value.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test that loads the real data/balance.json and pins placement values equal to the embedded mirrors.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: separation boundaries, tier placement, port ceilings, replay byte-identity, log round-trip, catalog parse all unit-pinned (test_place_min_separation_radius, test_mid_high_port_ceilings, test_mid_high_placement_replays_byte_identical) plus router_ceiling/router_tiers T1+T2 captures. P1 ≈80%: catalog fail-fast negatives, tier renders, replay-gate integration covered; tray type_idx arming uncovered. Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Cover the tray chip→type_idx handoff (app-level test or input-replay capture) to bring P1 to 100% — then PASS.
